pa-policy-adaptation.txt:
Assign the PA code for the substantive policy in the bill summary; statute title, agency name, amendment form, and appropriation wording alone do not determine the code. Resolutions, studies, and commemorative designations receive substantive codes. For broad omnibus changes across unrelated agencies or subjects, use general state government operations 2000 (pacd50168f1df86d46). Codebook: 105 covers state operating/capital budgets and debt; the general appropriations act is always 105. General state taxes or broad tax reform are 107, but specific tax changes follow their substantive subject. Avoid 336 for new observations; the codebook says it is being phased out.

Family, crime, courts: Child protective services, abuse/neglect, reports, investigations, expunction, child-focused services studies, and a representative's immunity for a minor child: 1207 (pa4adcb5d2d2f1fd3d, pa3bf926138f19c47b, paa69601a734f0d337). Probation-violation sanctions and arson offenses: 1210 (pafeb8fb301d889bc6, pac333ffd6a95be1d4). Judiciary procedure, aggravating circumstance, civil-action money paid into court, and licensing verbatim reporters: 1204 (pa3364fc1cf6f532e9, pafb5e447a83d2dc9a, pa7e4bcfc0ffddff33). Prisoner removal for serious illness, prison physicians, and use of Corrections appropriations: corrections 1205 (padece2a67da68a1a2, pad5f1fb59d8636171, pa61656c553edf2265). Organized anticrime community network grants: 1211 (padb8426e8f73a41bd). Realty transfer tax exemption and tax on jointly held real property: real estate/property law 1213 (pa6070ce7a018b46e0, pab27bfae9fb7258b0).

Health and welfare: Senior property-tax/rent rebates and inflation dividends: senior assistance 1303 (pab1d4780fef63ec80). Mental-patient abuse study: mental health 333 (paecce1916bcc5a1d2). Drug and alcohol treatment or program support, including minor commitment and township appropriations: 342 (pa98086617d5b997c4, pa3193ad35ed80e123). Volunteer ambulance service providers: emergency medical services 345 (pa83cb375006572d0a). Medical/health savings account income-tax treatment: general health 300 (paa7f2cd241f2e4d4b). COBRA anniversary: health insurance 301 (pa4f2f3782a3996d1f). Health insurer second medical opinion before surgery: 302 (padfcdcfc7d886db2f). Multi-part managed-care safeguards, utilization review, insurer disclosures, and access to providers: 323 (padee366eb079c2f3c). Government employee retirement eligibility/definitions, injured-employee salary/benefits, and public-school labor impasse procedures: 2004 (pa1ec0e482798e007c, pa3ea3a743cb90b85b, pa64feb0dc096a9e89, pa85672ae6acf3b1b3). Agency rental payments to General State Authority: 2008 (pa662657cd155596f2). Absentee voting and absentee ballot regulation also 2012 (pa17f7c790de58892b, pa262af054fb27e2c9); distinguish voting rights 206 from election administration 2012. County controller accounts/budget: local operations 2401 (pa43db867bc0eb97ef). Borough general powers: local powers 2402 (pafa483792ba6aa41b). Property-tax exemptions and study eliminating local school property taxes: local taxation 2404 (pa72e14c00b7707516, pa7d872dc972027d3d). Distinguish government privacy/open records 208 from private-firm internet-data privacy 1709.

Retired workers at a named firm: worker assistance 503 (pac38dbb213cda690d). Prevailing Wage Act scope: wages 505 (pae21234f71b487529). Nonprofit corporations' affiliation, activities, and tax status disclosure: 1520 (pa1d347b3201287045). Liquor license and malt-beverage sales regulation: 1528 (pa1142fa4ece785f78). Professional licensure fee account and budget: 1527 (pa30b203e9c1d791ed). Architects' Day: professional occupations 2030 (pa8bd5c3331f70aa89).

Transportation and land: Vehicle conviction points/speed timing, windshield equipment, and reformulated-fuel program rescission: 1006 (pa53688a4b527141f9, pa0aacd4403ddb461a, pa41c70294b37c878c). Highway rights-of-way and road speed limits: 1002 (pa8ae49af93c2b73e6, paf0d5abb3b9e2af00). Airport property divestiture: aviation 1003 (paae55d28c621627b1). Snowmobile recreational trails on public/private land: recreation/public lands 2103 (pad91c0105e3aea937).

Commemorations follow subject: Tartan Day ethnic heritage 201 (pa439c6dd0600ad954); volunteer week 1305; health awareness 331; architects 2030. Code from what the summary actually says, particularly when little detail is given.
